value.rationale: The source relies on a fixed local derivative-energy estimate, so determining its complete optimal coefficient tradeoff is a natural structural problem. The theorem identifies the entire Pareto boundary, supplies impossibility below it, and realizes every boundary point by an affine map. This gives reusable flexibility in later arguments where the energy and additive-defect terms have different mathematical costs.
